lines.en: My friend, Hugh, has always been fat, but things got so bad recently that he decided to go on a diet.
lines.zh: 我的朋友休一直很胖，但是近来情况变得越发糟糕，以致他决定节食。

lines.en: He began his diet a week ago.
lines.zh: 他是一星期前开始节食的。

lines.en: First of all, he wrote out a long list of all the foods which were forbidden.
lines.zh: 首先，他开列了一张长长的单子，上面列了所有禁吃的食物。

lines.en: The list included most of the things Hugh loves: butter, potatoes, rice, beer, milk, chocolate; and sweets.
lines.zh: 这张单子上的大多数食物都是休喜欢吃的：黄油、土豆、米饭、啤酒、牛奶、巧克力和糖果。

lines.en: Yesterday I paid him a visit.
I rang the bell and was not surprised to see that Hugh was still as fat as ever.
lines.zh: 我按响了门铃，当看到休仍和往常一样胖时，我并不感到惊奇。

lines.en: He led me into his room and hurriedly hid a large parcel under his desk.
lines.zh: 他把我领进屋，慌忙把一个大包藏到了桌子下面。

lines.en: It was obvious that he was very embarrassed.
When I asked him what he was doing, he smiled guiltily and then put the parcel on the desk.
lines.zh: 当我问他正干什么时，他内疚地笑了，然后把那个大包拿到了桌上。

lines.en: He explained that his diet was so strict that he had to reward himself occasionally .
lines.zh: 他解释说，他的饮食控制得太严格了，以致不得不偶尔奖赏自己一下。

lines.en: Then he showed me the contents of the parcel.
lines.zh: 接着他给我看了包里的东西。

lines.en: It contained five large bars of chocolate and three bags of sweets!
lines.zh: 里面装了5大块巧克力和3袋糖果！

question.en: Why did Hugh's diet not work?

words.zh: forbid sb. to do sth.:禁止某人做某事

当我问他正干什么时，他内疚地笑了，然后把那个大包拿到了桌上。
他解释说，他的饮食控制得太严格了，以致不得不偶尔奖赏自己一下。
接着他给我看了包里的东西。
里面装了5大块巧克力和3袋糖果！
